prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Chlorine (염소) itself — the sovereign of the Chlorine Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: chlorine: a pale yellow-green gas that is poison in a cloud and cleanliness in a drop — the clarity of a swimming pool, bleached white linen snapping in the wind, the sharp clean smell; the other half of sea salt; it disinfects, bleaches and purifies. Palette: chlorine yellow-green, bleach white, pool aqua, hazard black.

World (fixed): year 2200, an ocean purification megastructure: a spotless sanitized white city on stilts over the sea, hazard-striped decks, banks of translucent yellow-green gas tanks. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume colours (ours): chlorine yellow-green, bleach white, pool aqua, hazard black.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): pale yellow-green hair with a misty translucency. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Mecha (fixed): she is a female mecha personification — her whole body is covered in solid hard-surface mecha armour plates with visible thickness, joints, panel lines and glow lines, never cloth or a gown; no cloth robe, gown, skirt or long fabric over the plates — any cape, skirt or wing is rigid armoured plates. Her face and hair stay human.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

Her own original design: an adult woman in her mid-twenties with fair warm skin, short soft oval face, bright sky-blue eyes, fine brows, small nose and softly red lips, poised confident expression. Pale yellow-green hair with a misty translucency, shoulder-length layered waves with swept bangs. Slender athletic curvy build. Mecha silhouette: sparse outer plates over an exposed mechanical skeleton of metal struts, pistons and cables, light and precise. Hard bleach-white armor with hazard-black joints, yellow-green translucent gas chambers and pool-aqua glow. Signature construction: rigid branching filtration ribs and sealed translucent membrane cassettes form the articulated torso, thigh and shin armor, structurally like an ocean purification filter stack. Chest, waist, shoulders, arms and legs have solid plates with visible thickness, joints, panel lines and glow lines. Bold designed neckline and small skin gaps at upper arms and upper thighs; intimate areas covered; no fabric skirt or cloak. Both hands are ordinary human hands, empty with five fingers. She stands on a year-2200 ocean purification service deck, body gently angled, feet grounded, one hand raised open beside a clear treatment conduit and the other low, facing the viewer at eye level. White city on stilts, sea horizon, banks of translucent yellow-green tanks and aqua light.

One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except Cl and 17, only integrated into scene objects or costume, never a floating label or overlay; no logo or watermark.
